turns.text: Well, that's a fascinating and sensitive question. It highlights how perception can really deviate from shared reality during psychosis. While we can’t precisely describe sounds experienced subjectively, individuals sometimes report a sense of static, buzzing, or even a "pressure" in their ears, alongside the voices. It’s more about altered sensory processing than literally hearing nothing, you see.
